description: Oíche, meaning ‘night’ in Irish, is the debut album from Fears. It was recorded and produced in three bedrooms, hospital, and at the Domino Recordings studio in Brixton.
credits:
Recorded by Constance Keane and Katie O’Neill (3,7).

Mixed by Constance Keane.

Mastered by Huntley Miller.

Photography by Bríd O’Donovan.

Design by Cathy Flynn.
